instruction: Give a 1-star rating to all songs in my Spotify song library which I have not liked. If I have already rated it higher, decrease it to 1.

steps.code:
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='brenda.webe@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]

all_library_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_library_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Library songs:", len(all_library_songs))
print(all_library_songs[:3])

all_liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

liked_song_ids = set(s["song_id"] for s in all_liked_songs)
print("Liked songs:", len(all_liked_songs))

unliked_library_songs = [s for s in all_library_songs if s["song_id"] not in liked_song_ids]
print("Unliked library songs:", len(unliked_library_songs))
for s in unliked_library_songs:
    print(s["song_id"], s["title"])
